headline: Sarri under pressure as Frosinone arrive above Atalanta
summary: Maurizio Sarri is under pressure at Atalanta, and Italian media report his position depends on the next 2 matches. The table explains the scrutiny: Frosinone arrive 6th with 13 points, above an Atalanta side that has already lost 4 league games. The visitors also bring Serie A's top scorer, Antonio Raimondo, on 7 goals, and have won 3 of their last 5. The market still makes Atalanta favourites, though their win chance has slipped from 56.0% to 52.8%, and they are rated only 0.65 of a goal better. With both teams to score priced at 65.5%, an open game is more likely than not.
read: Atalanta are still the favourites at 52.8% but the price has come back in recent days, with Sarri under pressure in the Italian press and his side 11th on 9 points. Frosinone arrive sixth on 13 points with the league's top scorer, Antonio Raimondo on 7 goals, and the market expects goals: both teams to score is at 65.5% and the handicap line is under a full goal.

facts.fact: Italian media report that Atalanta coach Maurizio Sarri is under pressure, with Thiago Motta and Tudor named as possible replacements, and that his position depends heavily on the next two matches, against Ajax and then Frosinone.
facts.meaning: The home bench is being framed as on the line in this fixture, which colours everything Atalanta do on Sunday.

facts.fact: Frosinone sit sixth in Serie A with 13 points from seven games; Atalanta are 11th with 9.
Antonio Raimondo is Serie A's top scorer with 7 goals in seven matchdays, including a hat-trick in Frosinone's 4-2 win over Sassuolo five days ago.
facts.meaning: Frosinone carry the league's hottest striker into Bergamo, which is exactly why the market still gives them a real share of this game.

facts.fact: Atalanta's win chance has been trimmed from 56.0% to 52.8% in recent days, with Frosinone drifting out to 24.3%.
facts.meaning: The home side is still a clear favourite, but the market has taken some of the conviction out of it.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line sits at -0.65 goals for Atalanta, down from -0.8 at the start of the week.
facts.meaning: The market rates Atalanta less than a full goal better than Frosinone at home — a favourite expected to win, not to win comfortably.

facts.fact: Atalanta's league run reads LWLLL: three wins, no draws and four defeats from seven games, most recently 3-2 away at AC Milan.
facts.meaning: There is no draw in this Atalanta season so far — their matches are being decided, and lately decided against them.

facts.fact: Frosinone's last five league matches read WLWDW, three wins and 10 goals scored.
facts.meaning: The visitors arrive in the better rhythm of the two teams and with the confidence of a side that expects to score.

facts.fact: Frosinone have allowed 2.24 expected goals per game on average across their last five matches.
facts.meaning: They give up good chances even while winning, so Atalanta should find openings — the question is what Atalanta do with them.

sources.fact: Italian media report that Atalanta coach Maurizio Sarri is under pressure, with Thiago Motta and Tudor named as possible replacements.
La Repubblica reports that Sarri keeps the club's confidence for now, but his position depends heavily on the two-match stretch against Ajax and then Frosinone.
Atalanta lost 3-2 to AC Milan in Serie A, having trailed for much of the match before mounting a fightback.
Sarri said his side alternates good spells with moments of major limitations, doing well for 30-40 minutes in every match.
Italian media describe Atalanta as having had a difficult start to the season and a difficult spell in the league.
Italian media report that Sarri is making room for young players, with U23 players Obric and Idele leading Atalanta's new green line.
Frosinone beat Sassuolo 4-2 at home, with Antonio Raimondo scoring a hat-trick, to move into the Serie A top four.
Antonio Raimondo of Frosinone is the Serie A top scorer with 7 goals after seven matchdays.
